header:
Awesome SaaS and Indie Hacking Tools

> Open-source starters, billing, auth, analytics, email, hosting and admin tools for building and running a small software business. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Buy before you build** for auth and billing when you can.
- **Check the license.** Some tools are source-available with limits for hosting as a service.
- **Own your data.**
- **Ship the smallest version** and talk to users.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
